summary_1line: Before dawn, music praises Bharata, who rejects kingship and laments Rama’s exile as Sage Vasishtha enters the royal assembly.

image_candidates.scene_text: Before sunrise, bards beat great drums with golden sticks and blow conches while Bharata stands sorrowful in the palace court.
Prince Bharata, distressed, commands the musicians to stop while palace women around him begin to weep.
Sage Vasishtha enters the gem-encrusted royal council hall like Indra entering heaven, followed by attendants.
